purpose: Independent annotation quality and dataset-suitability review, not protocol optimization on validation
allocation: 18 joint cells; proportional to eligible train cell size; largest-remainder allocation; seeded SRS without replacement within each cell; collapse empty cells; record actual inclusion probabilities; no fabricated cell sizes
eligibility: Strictly readable paired original RGB/category/human/part IDs; retain all failures in separate integrity evidence; do not silently repair or delete
review: All native person instances; original RGB, Human_ids and Category_ids plus per-human planes; record confirmed/suspected/uncertain separately; 2 independent reviewers where feasible
rare_label_diagnostics: Additional separately named purposive train examples, outside prevalence sample unless probability-weighted
population_estimator: Only after all sampled review outcomes are resolved; report strata weights, image-level and person-level denominators separately; uncertainty and reviewer disagreement; no prevalence estimate now
validation_policy: Read-only integrity and duplication audit permitted; no model inference or tuning; preserve official list; any sensitivity view additional only
